source.title: Going Under
source.description:
In its day the so-called Sunken Temple was home to a sect of trolls dedicated to the resurrection of their ancient blood deity, Hakkar the Soul-Flayer. Before the Atal'ai could realize their grim ambitions, Ysera's wrath smote the temple into the mire and she left the dragon Eranikus and his host as its guardians. Of late I have heard many whispers of trolls once again active there, and I fear what may have become of the dragons there.

Please, venture inside the temple and see what you can learn.
source.objective: Find out more about what is happening in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
source.progress: What news do you bring of Eranikus?
source.completion: The scene you described is most harrowing. This is far worse than I feared. I can only hope that some of the dragons there yet live and can be rallied.
